governing_rule: Clause V2-SEC-4: Any case involving exported customer data to an external destination must be denied unless a security-approved override explicitly names that exact destination and exact use case.
conflicting_signals: Manager approval present and note supports export
Policy v2 requires denial for external exports of customer data
Manager note lacks security countersign and does not cover exact destination/use case
reason: The case involves exported customer data to an external destination (analytics sandbox mirror eu). Policy v2 Clause V2-SEC-4 requires denial unless there is a security-approved override naming the exact destination and exact use case. The manager note is not countersigned by security, and it does not cover the exact destination variant (eu) or the exact use case (vendor escalation vs. fraud-model drift review). Therefore, the manager note cannot override the v2 policy requirement.
